# PhysicsStats

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** both · **Folder:** [`src/logic/components/`](../folders/src-logic-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/components/rigid_body.h`](../../../src/logic/components/rigid_body.h)

## Summary

Physics counters and timings shown by the debug menu.

## Description

Context variable created on demand by physicsStats(reg) (src/physics/physics_sys.cpp), first called from RigidBodySys::preinit; PhysicsSys and TerrainCollidersSys fill it each frame on the host registry; DebugMenuSys displays it.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bodies` | `uint32_t` | 0 | bodies in the PhysicsSystem |
| `active_bodies` | `uint32_t` | 0 | awake bodies |
| `terrain_cells` | `uint32_t` | 0 | active terrain collider cells |
| `terrain_triangles` | `uint32_t` | 0 | triangles of the terrain colliders |
| `steps_last_frame` | `int` | 0 | fixed steps taken this frame |
| `step_ms` | `float` | 0 | time spent stepping |
| `colliders_ms` | `float` | 0 | time spent building terrain colliders |

- **Creates / emplaces:** [PhysicsSys](../systems/PhysicsSys.md), [RigidBodySys](../systems/RigidBodySys.md), [TerrainCollidersSys](../systems/TerrainCollidersSys.md)
